Video 17: Keeper stays face-hidden, slow push-in, candle smoke, silhouettes stay (good, only the Mira silhouette is a long-haired girl). Story: the hall sequence (p4-p10) is the strongest part - the stone trick is clever and Dan's own plan pays off; p3 narration jumps to 'Hall of Words' before the Gate and might confuse; the fresco reveal (p11) lands well but Mira's 'No one' needs the fresco to show two girls clearly (here a woman and a child), and the Silent suddenly taking the gate path in p14-16 happens without any explanation of why it came - fine as mystery. Different art styles between panels (cream framed p1/p4/p15 vs dark painterly p9/p10) make the chapter feel patchy.
